_comment: The map between an A3 channel and the REAPER project, plus the OSC
addresses this system speaks. Lifted out of a3-core.py, where both
were literals -- four records of eight track numbers, and forty-five
address templates with placeholders taken from them.
It ships with the package, beside the REAPER project it has to agree
with, and an update replaces it. That is on purpose: a track number
that no longer matches the shipped project is worse than a lost local
edit. The files under /etc are the other case -- see
Channels are in order, one record each. Every field listed in
a3_core_layout.CHANNEL_FIELDS has to be there: a missing number would
read as track 0 and quietly drive whatever REAPER has there.
